welcome.title: Welcome to atlas.core
welcome.description: Your unified system for workouts, nutrition, progress, and performance. Let us show you around.

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.description: Track your daily calorie and macro intake. Build personalized meal plans and log everything in one place.

workouts.title: Workouts
workouts.description: Create, organize, and track your training sessions. Pick from templates or build your own. Log every set and rep.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Take regular photos to track your body transformation. Visualize your evolution over time.

profile.title: Your Profile
profile.description: Set your goal, weight, height, and other metrics. This helps us personalize everything for you.

complete.title: You're all set
complete.description: Everything is ready. Good luck on your performance journey!
